"""LLM factory: OpenRouter models via ADK's LiteLlm wrapper.

ADK talks to Gemini natively; for anything else it ships `LiteLlm`, which hands the
call to LiteLLM. LiteLLM understands `openrouter/<vendor>/<model>` strings, so one
OpenRouter key gives every agent access to OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Mistral, etc.

Pick models that support tool/function calling — the specialists depend on it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable

from google.adk.models.base_llm import BaseLlm
from google.adk.models.lite_llm import LiteLlm

from app.core.config import get_settings

# Tests swap this to inject a scripted fake model (see tests/fake_llm.py).
_override: Callable[[str], BaseLlm] | None = None


def set_model_override(factory: Callable[[str], BaseLlm] | None) -> None:
    global _override
    _override = factory


def build_model(role: str = "specialist") -> BaseLlm:
    """role: 'root' or 'specialist' — lets you run a stronger router and cheaper specialists."""
    if _override is not None:
        return _override(role)
    s = get_settings()
    model_name = s.root_model if role == "root" else s.specialist_model
    return LiteLlm(
        model=model_name,
        api_key=s.openrouter_api_key or None,
        api_base=s.openrouter_api_base,
        temperature=s.llm_temperature,
        max_tokens=s.llm_max_tokens,
        timeout=s.llm_timeout_s,
        num_retries=2,
        # OpenRouter uses these for attribution/rankings; harmless otherwise.
        extra_headers={"HTTP-Referer": "https://github.com/retail-adk-agents", "X-Title": s.app_name},
    )

"""A scripted stand-in for the real LLM so tests run offline, free and deterministically,
while still exercising the real ADK machinery: Runner, transfers, tool execution,
DatabaseSessionService persistence and SSE streaming.

Behaviour, decided from which tools ADK put on the request:
  coordinator (has transfer_to_agent, no domain tools) -> transfer to a specialist
                                                          picked by keyword
  specialist, no tool result yet                       -> call its first domain tool
  specialist, after a tool result                      -> answer in text
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator

from google.adk.models.base_llm import BaseLlm
from google.adk.models.llm_request import LlmRequest
from google.adk.models.llm_response import LlmResponse
from google.genai import types

ROUTES = {
    "return": "returns_agent",
    "refund": "returns_agent",
    "order": "order_agent",
    "policy": "support_agent",
    "shipping": "support_agent",
}

TOOL_PLAN = {
    "search_products": {"query": "headphones"},
    "list_my_orders": {},
    "check_return_eligibility": {"order_id": "ORD-10001"},
    "get_store_policy": {"topic": "shipping"},
}


def _last_user_text(req: LlmRequest) -> str:
    for c in reversed(req.contents or []):
        if c.role == "user" and c.parts and any(p.text for p in c.parts):
            return " ".join(p.text or "" for p in c.parts).lower()
    return ""


def _last_function_response(req: LlmRequest):
    if not req.contents:
        return None
    last = req.contents[-1]
    for p in last.parts or []:
        if p.function_response:
            return p.function_response
    return None


class FakeLlm(BaseLlm):
    model: str = "fake-llm"

    async def generate_content_async(self, llm_request: LlmRequest, stream: bool = False) -> AsyncGenerator[LlmResponse, None]:
        tools = set((llm_request.tools_dict or {}).keys())
        domain_tools = [t for t in TOOL_PLAN if t in tools]
        fr = _last_function_response(llm_request)

        if fr is not None and fr.name != "transfer_to_agent":
            text = f"Here is what I found via {fr.name}: status={fr.response.get('status')}."
            if stream:
                half = len(text) // 2
                yield LlmResponse(content=types.Content(role="model", parts=[types.Part(text=text[:half])]), partial=True)
                yield LlmResponse(content=types.Content(role="model", parts=[types.Part(text=text[half:])]), partial=True)
            yield LlmResponse(content=types.Content(role="model", parts=[types.Part(text=text)]), turn_complete=True)
            return

        if domain_tools:
            name = domain_tools[0]
            call = types.FunctionCall(name=name, args=TOOL_PLAN[name])
        elif "transfer_to_agent" in tools:
            msg = _last_user_text(llm_request)
            target = next((agent for kw, agent in ROUTES.items() if kw in msg), "catalog_agent")
            call = types.FunctionCall(name="transfer_to_agent", args={"agent_name": target})
        else:
            yield LlmResponse(content=types.Content(role="model", parts=[types.Part(text="Hello!")]))
            return
        yield LlmResponse(content=types.Content(role="model", parts=[types.Part(function_call=call)]))

POST /api/v1/chat          -> one JSON response when the turn is finished
POST /api/v1/chat/stream   -> Server-Sent Events (what the web UI uses)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

from app.routers.deps import get_agent_service
from app.schemas import ChatRequest, ChatResponse
from app.services.agent_service import COORDINATOR, AgentService, UpstreamLLMError

router = APIRouter(prefix="/chat", tags=["chat"])


def sse_response(gen) -> StreamingResponse:
    async def frames():
        async for evt in gen:
            yield f"event: {evt['type']}\ndata: {json.dumps(evt, default=str)}\n\n"

    return StreamingResponse(
        frames(),
        media_type="text/event-stream",
        # X-Accel-Buffering stops proxies buffering the stream; Cloud Run streams fine.
        headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache", "X-Accel-Buffering": "no"},
    )


@router.post("", response_model=ChatResponse)
async def chat(req: ChatRequest, svc: AgentService = Depends(get_agent_service)):
    try:
        result = await svc.chat(COORDINATOR, req.user_id, req.message, req.session_id, req.customer_id)
    except TimeoutError as e:
        raise HTTPException(504, "Agent run timed out") from e
    except UpstreamLLMError as e:
        raise HTTPException(502, f"LLM provider error ({e}). Check OPENROUTER_API_KEY and the model name.") from e
    return ChatResponse(**result.__dict__)


@router.post("/stream")
async def chat_stream(req: ChatRequest, svc: AgentService = Depends(get_agent_service)):
    return sse_response(svc.stream(COORDINATOR, req.user_id, req.message, req.session_id, req.customer_id))
